cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(tab5_decoder_test C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
get_filename_component(project_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(root "${project_root}/external/openh264")
file(GLOB common "${root}/codec/common/src/*.cpp")
file(GLOB decoder "${root}/codec/decoder/core/src/*.cpp" "${root}/codec/decoder/plus/src/*.cpp")
# Use the identical reference-picture fixes generated by the firmware build.
list(REMOVE_ITEM decoder "${root}/codec/decoder/core/src/decoder_core.cpp" "${root}/codec/decoder/plus/src/welsDecoderExt.cpp" "${root}/codec/decoder/core/src/cabac_decoder.cpp" "${root}/codec/decoder/core/src/parse_mb_syn_cabac.cpp" "${root}/codec/decoder/core/src/decode_slice.cpp")
list(APPEND decoder "${project_root}/components/openh264_sw/cabac_decoder_esp.cpp")
set(patches "${project_root}/build/esp-idf/openh264_sw")
add_library(openh264 STATIC ${common} ${decoder} "${patches}/decoder_core_esp.cpp" "${patches}/welsDecoderExt_esp.cpp" "${patches}/parse_mb_syn_cabac_esp.cpp" "${patches}/decode_slice_esp.cpp")
target_include_directories(openh264 PUBLIC "${root}/codec/api" "${root}/codec/api/wels" PRIVATE "${root}/codec/common/inc" "${root}/codec/decoder/core/inc" "${root}/codec/decoder/plus/inc" "${project_root}/components/openh264_sw")
target_compile_options(openh264 PRIVATE -O1 -fno-strict-aliasing -w)
add_executable(test_decoder test_decoder.cpp "${project_root}/main/core/video_decoder.cpp" "${project_root}/main/core/pixel_convert.c" "${project_root}/main/core/video_queue.c" "${project_root}/main/core/touch.c" "${project_root}/components/airplay_screen/airplay_screen_codec.c")
target_include_directories(test_decoder PRIVATE "${project_root}/main" "${project_root}/components/airplay_screen/include")
target_link_libraries(test_decoder PRIVATE openh264 pthread)
target_compile_options(test_decoder PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -UNDEBUG)
